items.dir: Directions: Many Chinese students can read English well but speak poorly. Write an essay suggesting how to improve spoken English. You should write 120 to 180 words.
ol: 点明问题：输入多、输出少
fr: 第一段：问题界定，不是词汇不足而是缺少输出
第二段：三条措施（固定口语时段、录音回听、真实交流）
第三段：执行要点（短而频繁）
items.es:
Many Chinese students read English comfortably yet freeze when they must speak. The problem is rarely vocabulary; it is the absence of practice in producing sentences under time pressure.

Three measures help. First, set a daily ten-minute speaking slot in which no Chinese is allowed, even if the sentences are simple. Second, record yourself and listen once. Most learners are unaware of repeated fillers and flat intonation until they hear their own voice. Third, find one real conversation partner — a language exchange app, a classmate, a teacher's office hour — because speaking to a screen does not reproduce the pressure of being understood.

What matters is frequency rather than duration. Twenty minutes twice a day builds the habit; a three-hour session on Sunday does not. Progress will feel slow for about six weeks, then suddenly audible in a recording. The method is unglamorous, but it is the only one that transfers to a real conversation.
ph: freeze when they must speak 一到开口就卡住
under time pressure 在时间压力下
unaware of repeated fillers 没意识到重复的口头填充词
frequency rather than duration 频率而非时长

items.dir: Directions: Food waste is serious on many campuses. Write an essay suggesting how to reduce it. You should write 120 to 180 words.
ol: 描述浪费的规模与环节
从食堂、学生、制度三方面提措施
fr: 第一段：指出浪费集中在哪些环节
第二段：三条措施（份量可选、临期折扣、称重反馈）
第三段：为什么这些措施能落地
items.es:
On many campuses, food waste happens less in kitchens than on trays: rice left half-eaten, dishes ordered and abandoned. Reducing it requires changes at three points.

First, canteens should offer two portion sizes at two prices. Most students do not intend to waste food; they simply cannot finish the standard portion. Second, unsold food near closing time should be discounted rather than discarded, with a clear time label so that freshness is not compromised. Third, some universities have begun weighing leftovers and publishing daily totals per canteen; visibility alone reduces waste, because no one wants to be the worst performer on a public board.

Student action matters too. A campaign that asks diners to order one dish fewer and add later if still hungry is easy to run and easy to follow.

None of these measures requires new technology. They require a decision to measure, and a willingness to make the smaller portion normal.
ph: happens less in kitchens than on trays 与其说发生在厨房，不如说在餐盘上
near closing time 临近打烊
so that freshness is not compromised 以免影响新鲜度
make the smaller portion normal 让小份变成常态

items.dir: Directions: Many students suffer from exam anxiety. Write an essay suggesting ways to cope with it. You should write 120 to 180 words.
ol: 区分有益紧张与有害焦虑
fr: 第一段：界定问题，焦虑的两种形态
第二段：措施（模拟考试、呼吸训练、认知重构）
第三段：何时寻求专业帮助
items.es:
Exam anxiety is not a single condition. A certain level of tension improves performance by focusing attention; the problem begins when physical symptoms — a racing heart, a blank mind — prevent a student from using what she knows.

First, practise under the conditions of the real examination: same duration, same silence, no phone. Familiarity removes a large part of the fear, because the unknown is what the body reacts to. Second, learn a simple breathing routine, four counts in and six counts out, and use it in the two minutes before entering the hall. Third, replace the thought 'I must not fail' with 'I will do the first question, then the second', because the mind cannot hold a vague threat and a concrete task at the same time.

If anxiety persists for weeks, affects sleep, or appears without any examination in sight, the student should speak to a counsellor. Early help is far more effective than last-minute endurance.
ph: a racing heart 心跳加速
practise under the conditions of the real examination 在真实考试条件下练习
the unknown is what the body reacts to 身体反应的是未知
in sight 在望、即将到来

items.ti: 如何提高图书馆利用率
items.dir: Directions: A university library is well equipped but underused. Write an essay suggesting how to make better use of it. You should write 120 to 180 words.
ol: 从空间、服务、推广三方面提建议
fr: 第一段：说明「设备好但人少」的原因
第二段：三条建议（分区、嵌入课程、数据驱动采购）
第三段：如何衡量效果
items.es:
A library with new furniture and few readers is a common paradox. The cause is usually not the building but the mismatch between what it offers and how students actually work.

Three changes would help. First, divide the space by function: a silent floor, a discussion floor and a floor where food and calls are allowed. Students avoid libraries when they cannot predict which rule applies where. Second, embed the library in teaching. When a course requires a session with a subject librarian, usage rises immediately and stays higher, because students learn what the databases contain. Third, let borrowing data shape purchases; buying more of what is actually requested is more effective than buying according to a list.

Success should be measured by seats occupied at three in the afternoon, not by the number of volumes held. A library is working when it is difficult to find a chair.
ph: a common paradox 常见的悖论
the mismatch between A and B A 与 B 之间的错配
embed the library in teaching 把图书馆嵌入教学
Seats occupied ... not by the number of volumes 以座位使用率而非藏书量衡量

items.dir: Directions: Many university students do little exercise. Write an essay suggesting how to encourage them to take part in sports. You should write 120 to 180 words.
ol: 说明不运动的真实原因
提出降低门槛的三条措施
fr: 第一段：原因不是懒，而是门槛与时间
第二段：措施（短时段课程、同伴组队、场地预约透明）
第三段：激励如何避免形式化
items.es:
Most students who avoid sport are not lazy; they face three practical barriers: no time, no partner and no idea where to start.

The first barrier is best addressed with short sessions. A thirty-minute class at lunchtime attracts people who will never commit to a ninety-minute training. The second is social: team registration with a friend doubles attendance, because skipping means letting someone down. The third is information: a single page showing which courts are free tonight, updated hourly, removes the frustration of arriving at a full gym.

Incentives need care. Requiring a fixed number of exercise sessions invites students to swipe a card and leave. It is better to reward participation in a league or a course that meets weekly, where attendance is visible and the activity has a social cost.

The goal is not to produce athletes but to make one hour of movement a normal part of the week.
ph: face three practical barriers 面临三个实际障碍
commit to 承诺投入
letting someone down 让某人失望
invites students to swipe a card and leave 促使学生刷个卡就走

items.dir: Directions: Conflicts in dormitories are common. Write an essay suggesting how to reduce them. You should write 120 to 180 words.
fr: 第一段：矛盾多源于未说出口的默认规则
第二段：措施（入住时定规则、轮值、冷却机制）
第三段：第三方调解的作用
items.es:
Dormitory conflicts are rarely about the obvious issues. They start with rules that no one stated: whether the light goes off at eleven, whether a friend may stay overnight, who buys the cleaning supplies.

Three measures reduce the friction. First, the first week should produce a short written agreement — five points are enough — because a rule agreed in advance is easier to invoke than a complaint invented in anger. Second, rotate responsibilities monthly, since the person who has taken out the rubbish for a term resents it more.

Some conflicts need a third party. A resident adviser who is trained to mediate, rather than to judge, can convert a shouting match into a negotiation about specific behaviour.

The aim is not friendship but predictability. Most people can live with difference; almost no one can live with uncertainty.
ph: rules that no one stated 没人明说过的规则
invoke 援引（规则）
rotate responsibilities 轮值
convert a shouting match into a negotiation 把吵架变成协商

items.dir: Directions: Many students stay silent in class. Write an essay suggesting how to increase participation. You should write 120 to 180 words.
ol: 从教师设计角度提三条建议
说明学生自身可做的改变
fr: 第一段：沉默不等于没想法
第二段：措施（先写后说、小组预热、点名可预期）
第三段：学生侧的准备
items.es:
Silence in class is usually not ignorance. Students report three reasons for not speaking: they need time to formulate a thought, they fear sounding foolish in front of a large group, and they do not know whether the point is welcome.

A teacher can remove all three obstacles with small design changes. Asking students to write for two minutes before discussion gives the slow thinkers something to read from. Starting in pairs, then merging pairs into fours, lowers the cost of a first contribution. Announcing that the first five minutes belong to questions, and that no question will be judged, sets an expectation that makes speaking normal.

Students have their own work to do. Reading the assigned text and writing one question before class changes the experience entirely, because a person with a prepared question is no longer improvising.

Participation is a habit produced by design and preparation, not a personality trait distributed unevenly among students.
ph: sound foolish 显得愚蠢
lower the cost of a first contribution 降低第一次发言的成本
no longer improvising 不再即兴发挥
distributed unevenly 分配不均

items.dir: Directions: Students are overwhelmed by information. Write an essay suggesting how to manage it. You should write 120 to 180 words.
fr: 第一段：过载不是信息太多，而是筛选成本太高
第二段：措施（固定信息时段、来源白名单、笔记沉淀）
第三段：以输出为标准
items.es:
Information overload is usually described as having too much to read. In practice, the difficulty is different: the cost of deciding what to ignore has become higher than the cost of reading.

Three measures help. First, confine intake to fixed periods — twenty minutes in the morning, twenty in the evening — rather than checking continuously, which fragments attention without adding knowledge. Second, keep a short list of trusted sources and read them thoroughly instead of sampling twenty accounts superficially. Third, write something after reading: three sentences summarising the argument are worth more than a saved bookmark that will never be opened.

The test of a reading habit is not how much has been consumed but what can be reproduced. A student who can explain one article a day to a friend is better informed than one who has skimmed forty.

Information becomes knowledge only when it is processed. Everything else is noise with a timestamp.
ph: the cost of deciding what to ignore 决定忽略什么的成本
confine intake to fixed periods 把信息摄入限制在固定时段
sampling ... superficially 浅层浏览
noise with a timestamp 带时间戳的噪音

items.ti: 如何鼓励毕业生到基层工作
items.dir: Directions: Some regions lack skilled graduates. Write an essay suggesting how to encourage graduates to work there. You should write 120 to 180 words.
ol: 说明毕业生顾虑的核心
强调长期发展而非一次性补贴
fr: 第一段：顾虑不是待遇单一因素
第二段：措施（职业通道、生活配套、服务期限弹性）
第三段：政策设计的关键
items.es:
Encouraging graduates to work in less developed regions fails when policy addresses only salary. The deeper concerns are career progression, daily life and the fear of being forgotten.

Three measures are more effective than a one-off subsidy. First, create a visible promotion path: a young teacher or doctor sent to a county should know that excellent work leads to further training and a route back to a larger institution, not to permanent exile. Second, fix the practical basics — housing, childcare, internet and transport — because these determine whether a spouse will agree to come. Third, allow flexible service periods, such as two years with an option to extend, which lowers the perceived commitment and attracts those who would never sign for five.

Money helps, but it cannot compensate for a career that appears to end at arrival. The message should be that service in a difficult region is a stage with a future, not a detour from one.
ph: a one-off subsidy 一次性补贴
permanent exile 永久流放
fix the practical basics 解决基本生活配套
a detour from one 绕离正路

items.ti: 如何改善城市空气质量
items.dir: Directions: Air pollution remains a problem in some cities. Write an essay suggesting how to improve air quality. You should write 120 to 180 words.
fr: 第一段：污染来源分散，单一措施无效
第二段：措施（能源、交通、区域联防）
第三段：长期监测与公众参与
items.es:
Air quality cannot be fixed by one measure, because the sources are distributed across several systems.

Three interventions matter most. First, the energy structure: replacing coal-fired heating and small industrial boilers with gas or electricity removes a large share of winter particulate matter. Second, transport: converting buses and taxis to electric power, and charging congestion fees in the centre, reduces nitrogen oxides where people actually breathe. Third, regional coordination: pollution does not respect administrative boundaries, so a city that cleans its own streets while its neighbour expands steel capacity will not see the benefit.

Monitoring should be public and continuous. When hourly data are available at street level, residents can adjust their behaviour and officials cannot claim improvement that the instruments deny.

Clean air is a long project with visible milestones. The measurable target should be the number of days below the standard, not the number of meetings held.
ph: distributed across several systems 分布在多个系统中
does not respect administrative boundaries 不分行政边界
cannot claim improvement that the instruments deny 无法宣称仪器否认的改善
visible milestones 可见的里程碑

items.dir: Directions: Local dialects are declining. Write an essay suggesting how to protect them. You should write 120 to 180 words.
ol: 说明保护与推广普通话不冲突
fr: 第一段：消失源于代际传递中断
第二段：措施（家庭使用、学校社团、数字记录）
第三段：澄清与普通话的关系
items.es:
Dialects disappear not because people stop liking them but because the chain of transmission breaks. When parents speak Mandarin to children and grandparents are the only dialect speakers, a language loses its next generation within thirty years.

First, families should keep one domain for the dialect — meals, calls to grandparents, festivals — so that children hear it in emotional contexts rather than as a performance. Second, schools can support dialect clubs and local opera performances as extracurricular activities, without adding to the examination burden. Third, universities and libraries should record elderly speakers systematically, including everyday conversation rather than only formal vocabulary, since it is the ordinary register that is vanishing fastest.

Protecting a dialect does not compete with promoting standard Chinese. A person can write in one and joke in the other, and most of the world's multilingual speakers do exactly that. The loss would not be a loss of communication but of a way of seeing.
ph: the chain of transmission breaks 传承链条断裂
keep one domain for 为……保留一个场景
the ordinary register 日常语域
compete with 与……冲突

items.dir: Directions: Public transport is losing passengers to private cars. Write an essay suggesting how to attract more riders. You should write 120 to 180 words.
fr: 第一段：流失不是价格问题
第二段：措施（准点率、换乘体验、专用道）
第三段：为何可靠性优先
items.es:
Passengers rarely abandon buses because of the fare. They leave because the bus is unpredictable, the transfer is unpleasant, or the journey takes twice as long as driving.

Three improvements follow directly. First, reliability: a bus that arrives every eight minutes does not require a timetable, and passengers stop checking apps. This depends on dedicated lanes, which are politically difficult but decisive. Second, transfers: a single ticket valid for ninety minutes across buses and the subway removes the penalty for changing vehicles. Third, information and shelter: real-time arrival displays and a roof at every stop cost little and change how the wait feels.

Priority matters. Reliability comes first, because a comfortable bus that arrives late is still useless. Frequency comes second, because waiting is the largest part of the perceived journey. Comfort comes third.

A city that makes the bus dependable does not need to persuade drivers to give up their cars; the arithmetic does it.
ph: abandon buses 放弃公交
dedicated lanes 公交专用道
removes the penalty for changing vehicles 取消换乘的额外成本
the perceived journey 感知到的行程时间

items.ti: 如何帮助新生适应大学
items.dir: Directions: Many freshmen find it hard to adapt to university life. Write an essay suggesting how to help them. You should write 120 to 180 words.
ol: 指出适应困难的三个方面
fr: 第一段：困难（学习方法、社交、生活自理）
第二段：措施（学业导师、朋辈辅导、生活课程）
第三段：责任分工
items.es:
Freshmen struggle with three things at once: a method of study that no longer works, a social world that must be rebuilt, and daily life that must be managed without parents.

The first difficulty is often invisible to the student. Someone who succeeded at school by memorising may fail at university, not from laziness but from using the wrong method; a short course on note-taking in the first month prevents a term of quiet failure. The second is social, and the third is daily life.

Responsibility should be shared rather than delegated. The university provides structure, the department provides mentors, and senior students provide the informal knowledge that makes an institution navigable.

Adaptation is not a personality test that some students fail. It is a skill that can be taught before it is needed.
ph: a social world that must be rebuilt 必须重建的社交世界
prevents a term of quiet failure 避免一整学期的无声失败
the questions that no one dares to ask 没人敢问的问题
navigable 可被摸清的

items.dir: Directions: Single-use plastics cause serious pollution. Write an essay suggesting how to reduce their use on campus. You should write 120 to 180 words.
ol: 说明一次性塑料的使用场景
提出替代与制度两类措施
fr: 第一段：用量集中在几个场景
第二段：替代方案 + 制度设计（押金、自带优惠）
第三段：便利性是关键
items.es:
On a campus, single-use plastic appears in a few predictable places: takeaway containers, drink cups, bags and delivery packaging. Because the sources are concentrated, they can be attacked directly.

Substitution is the first step. Canteens can offer a reusable box with a small deposit, refunded on return; the deposit must be high enough to matter and low enough not to deter. Cafes can give a one-yuan discount to anyone who brings a cup.

Convenience decides whether these measures survive. A reuse scheme that requires washing the box at home will fail in a dormitory without a kitchen; one with a washing station beside the collection point will work.

Reduction is not about heroism. It is about making the reusable option the easier one.
ph: can be attacked directly 可以被直接针对
high enough to matter and low enough not to deter 高到有约束力，低到不吓退人
by default rather than by request 默认而非按需
making the reusable option the easier one 让可重复使用成为更省事的选择

items.dir: Directions: China's population is ageing quickly. Write an essay suggesting how to improve community care for the elderly. You should write 120 to 180 words.
fr: 第一段：社区养老介于家庭与机构之间
第二段：措施（助餐、日间照料、上门医疗）
第三段：人力与支付
items.es:
Community care sits between the family and the institution, and it is the only model that can serve most older people at a cost the country can afford.

Three services matter most. The first is a meal service: a canteen that delivers lunch to those over eighty costs less than institutional care and removes the most common daily risk, a skipped meal. The second is day care, which gives family carers a few hours of relief.

Care work is poorly paid and rarely seen as a career. Training programmes, recognised certificates and a clear promotion path would help, and so would allowing younger volunteers to earn course credit.

Community care succeeds when it is close, cheap and reliable. Everything else is detail.
ph: sits between A and B 处于 A 与 B 之间
at a cost the country can afford 以国家负担得起的成本
gives family carers a few hours of relief 让家庭照护者喘口气
Everything else is detail 其余都是细节
